findings.cause: The exception handler catches every Exception instead of only ConnectionError.

findings.cause: dispatch now returns a dictionary, while command_response still expects the delivered identifier list.

findings.cause: Each batch copies the entire remaining deque into a list before slicing out batch_size entries.
findings.impact: Successful dispatch performs quadratic queue-copying work for a fixed batch size and allocates temporary lists proportional to the remaining queue depth.
findings.trigger: Flush a large queue through a transport that successfully accepts successive batches.
findings.evidence: For N notices and batch size B, the conversions copy N, N-B, N-2B, and subsequent remaining entries, totaling O(N²/B) references. A bounded iteration such as itertools.islice would copy only the next batch.
